title: JobMatch
desc:
Full-stack AI job finder using OpenAI APIs 
and agentic workflows with real-time job-search,
KV-backed rate limiting, and résumé parsing.

title: Fragments Microservices
desc:
Cloud-native microservice for CRUD on mixed content
(text, JSON, images) with Cognito auth enforced at the edge
and metadata split from binary storage.
tech: Node.js, Express, Amazon Cognito, DynamoDB, S3, Docker, GitHub Actions

title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
desc:
Trains a simulated self-driving car
using CNNs and reinforcement learning.

title: AI Emotion Detector
desc:
Lightweight CNN facial-emotion recognition
trained on FER2013, with a real-time labeled feed
and a growing sample corpus for training a
triplet-loss classifier against the cascade baseline.

title: Gaming Laptop AI Recommender
desc:
Scrapes live gaming-laptop listings
and serves AI-powered recommendations
through a chatbot.
